snippet.title: DIGGERGUN - Publisher Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist DIGGERGUN on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968180/DIGGERGUN/

Kabloop is excited to announce its partnership with video game publisher Grab The Games for the release of DIGGERGUN. 

The partnership between Kabloop and Grab The Games will enable DIGGERGUN to be released for PlayStation 4/5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch and Steam in late summer 2023 with support for multiple languages.

-----

About DIGGERGUN

DIGGERGUN is a life-sim, where players earn a minimum wage by digging through randomly generated mines looking for lithium. Trapped on an island with no option but to dig, how will you escape?
